_comment: Copy this to firebase-config.json (gitignored) to enable cloud play locally. In CI the same
JSON comes from the FIREBASE_CONFIG repo secret. With no file, the cloud courier is disabled
and nothing is fetched -- link play, hot-seat and vs-computer are unaffected.
Get the real values from the Firebase console: Project settings -> Your apps -> SDK setup
and configuration -> Config. The whole object is the secret, not just the apiKey: none of
these values is confidential (the database rules are the security boundary, not the key),
but keeping them out of the source tree is what stops a fork writing to our backend.
Replace this file's contents entirely -- the keys below are the shape, not real values.
Delete this _comment key in the real file; unknown keys are handed straight to the SDK.
apiKeyNative is OPTIONAL and is for Chess.Net (Android, and any desktop client): the browser
key is restricted to an HTTP referrer, and that restriction refuses a request sending no
Referer -- which is every native client. Register an Android app to get a second, unrestricted
key without touching the console: `firebase apps:create ANDROID <name> --package-name <pkg>`
then `firebase apps:sdkconfig ANDROID <appId>`. Omit the field and native clients fall back to
apiKey, which is correct for a project whose single key is unrestricted.
